data.text: I’m in on the same terms as Kate: 15 tons this month with the full $15,000 donated, provided John and Jack also commit and Luke catches zero. My family taught me to look after both the lake and the people who depend on it. Saving essential treatment warrants this exception, but the recovery month must be part of the agreement: no more than 6 tons each next month, then back to 10 each once the lake reaches 100 tons. John, can you commit?
